zh.d:
本版主打协作与会话整理：发送后可自动组织数字员工协作并跟踪任务待办；历史会话支持分组与拖拽整理；会话文件区自动挂载智能体交付的文件夹；MCP 管理全面升级；Windows 安装包首次带上正式数字签名；引擎侧记忆召回明显更精准（v0.1.107）。

【新增】
· 【自动协作】发送消息后可自动组织数字员工协作，默认留在当前会话执行；任务以「任务待办」清单展示并自动编号，可随时查看成员进度
· 【会话分组】历史会话支持新建分组、移动到分组、重命名与移除，会话与分组都可拖拽进项目，侧栏工作区快捷入口支持添加、排序与移除
· 【分享会话】历史会话可一键把内容分享到新会话继续追问
· 【交付文件夹】会话文件区自动附加智能体本轮交付的文件夹：成功写出的文件与回复中引用的文件，其所在目录自动挂到文件浏览器，不用再手动翻找
· 【模型健康检测】模型设置里可对单个模型发起健康检测，展示是否可用与延迟；企业托管的供应商检测结果只读展示，不写入本地配置
· 【快速分享】标题栏新增「分享 One Work」入口
· 【Windows 安装包签名】Windows 正式包接入 sslTrus 远程签名，安装包带 Authenticode 数字签名与时间戳（签名者：上海言绪科技有限公司），SmartScreen 与杀毒软件不再提示未知发布者

【优化改进】
· 【MCP 管理】服务器卡片新增「检测」按钮与「已开启/已关闭」状态标签，支持编辑用途备注，内置工具补齐用途说明；打开场景时遇到未开启的工具，改为「开启并打开」一键放行，不再要求手动进设置
· 【消息滚动】长对话自动滚动加固，新增向上/向下滚动按钮
· 【外网访问】中继支持节点间加密转发，访客请求自动路由到会话所有者所在节点，多节点部署不再绕路
· 【侧栏】分区操作按钮在明暗主题下视觉更柔和
· 【记忆召回】明显减少无关记忆召回；「这轮不用记忆」等轮次级范围被尊重；听懂中文的「不需要记忆／不要召回」指令

【修复】
· 【MCP 卡片】消息流中 MCP 工具卡片不再被后续内容顶走，知识工具提示文案本地化
· 【链接修复】设置与文档中指向失效域名 1one.1oneclaw.com 的四处链接改到官网文档页；钉钉渠道文档链接改指钉钉开放平台开发者后台

本版企业端共享单机版的全部会话协作、MCP 管理与引擎升级，并针对企业托管模型做了适配。

【共享升级】
· 自动协作、任务待办、会话分组与拖拽整理、分享会话、交付文件夹等全部会话协作能力（与单机版一致）
· MCP 管理升级：连接检测、开启状态标签、用途备注、场景工具一键开启（与单机版一致）
· 记忆召回修复：减少无关召回、遵循轮次来源范围、听懂中文的「不需要记忆」退出指令（引擎 v0.1.107）
· Windows 安装包正式签名：企业版 Windows 安装包同样带 Authenticode 签名与时间戳（上海言绪科技有限公司）

【企业适配】
· 模型健康检测对企业托管的供应商只读展示，不写入本地配置，避免覆盖管理后台下发的模型设置
· 企业模式下模型可用性检查与 MCP 工作流加固

en.d:
This release focuses on collaboration and conversation organization: send a message and digital employees can collaborate automatically with a trackable task checklist; history conversations gain grouping and drag-and-drop organizing; the conversation file area auto-mounts folders the agent delivered; MCP management gets a full upgrade; Windows installers carry a real digital signature for the first time; and memory recall on the engine side gets noticeably more precise (v0.1.107).

[New]
· Automatic collaboration: after sending, digital employees can be organized into an automatic collaboration that by default stays in the current chat; tasks appear in a numbered "task checklist" with member progress always visible
· Conversation groups: history conversations support creating groups, moving conversations into groups, renaming and removing; conversations and groups can be dragged into projects; sidebar workspace shortcuts support add, reorder and remove
· Share a conversation: share the content of a history conversation into a new session with one click
· Delivery folders: the conversation file area automatically attaches folders the agent delivered this round - directories containing files it successfully wrote or referenced in replies are mounted into the file browser automatically, no more manual hunting
· Model health check: run a health check on a single model from model settings, showing availability and latency; for enterprise-managed providers results are read-only and never written into local config
· Quick share: a new "Share One Work" entry in the title bar
· Windows installer signing: Windows release packages now use sslTrus remote signing - installers carry an Authenticode signature with timestamp (signer: Shanghai Yanxu Technology), so SmartScreen and antivirus no longer warn about an unknown publisher

[Improved]
· MCP management: server cards gain a "Check" button and on/off status labels, purpose notes are editable, built-in tools ship purpose descriptions; when opening a scene whose tools are disabled, a one-click "Enable and open" replaces the manual trip to settings
· Message scrolling: auto-scroll hardened for long conversations, with new scroll up/down buttons
· External access: relays now forward between nodes over an encrypted channel, routing visitor requests to the node that owns the session - no more detours in multi-node deployments
· Sidebar: section action buttons look softer across light and dark themes
· Memory recall: clearly fewer irrelevant recalls; turn-scoped requests like "no memory this turn" are honored; Chinese opt-out phrases ("no need for memory / don't recall") are understood

[Fixed]
· MCP cards: MCP tool cards in the message flow no longer get pushed around by later content; knowledge tool notes are localized
· Dead links: four links pointing at the defunct domain 1one.1oneclaw.com in settings and docs now lead to the official documentation pages; the DingTalk channel doc link now opens the DingTalk Open Platform developer console

The enterprise client shares all conversation collaboration, MCP management and engine upgrades from the personal edition, with adaptations for enterprise-managed models.

[Shared upgrades]
· All conversation collaboration capabilities: automatic collaboration, task checklist, conversation grouping and drag-and-drop, conversation sharing and delivery folders (matching the personal edition)
· MCP management upgrade: connection checks, on/off labels, purpose notes and one-click scene tool enabling (matching the personal edition)
· Memory recall fixes: fewer irrelevant recalls, turn-scoped source honored, and Chinese opt-out phrases understood (engine v0.1.107)
· Windows installer signing: enterprise Windows installers also carry an Authenticode signature with timestamp (Shanghai Yanxu Technology)

[Enterprise adaptations]
· Model health checks on enterprise-managed providers are read-only and never written into local config, so model settings pushed from the admin console cannot be overwritten
· Enterprise model availability checks and MCP workflows hardened
